lastaid.tutorial.welcome: Welcome to the Last Aid mod! This tutorial will guide you through this mod and explain the different mechanics.
lastaid.tutorial.line1: As you may already have noticed, the vanilla health bar is gone. It has been replaced by this system.
lastaid.tutorial.line2: Every part of your body has it's own health. So if you fall from a high place...
lastaid.tutorial.line3: One of your feet will be damaged! This may cause some debuffs to apply, like slowness for damaged feet, mining fatigue for damaged arms and so on.
lastaid.tutorial.line4: These effects may be bypassed by taking morphine or healing the wound.
lastaid.tutorial.line5: Wounds can be healed by applying bandages or plaster (right click the item).
lastaid.tutorial.sleephint: If you sleep in a bed, your body will automatically regenerate a little bit.
lastaid.tutorial.line6: A player can die, if a critical organ's health (head or body) drop to zero.
lastaid.tutorial.line7: In this case, the player would be dead, no matter how much health the other organs have.
lastaid.tutorial.line8: If you want to see your current health and active healers, just press %s to open this interface with your health.
lastaid.tutorial.end: That is the end of the tutorial.

lastaid.tip.commands.subheader: Click a bracketed command to prefill chat, or hover to view parameters and examples.
lastaid.tip.commands.pain.label: Pain
lastaid.tip.commands.pain.detail:
Pain intensity and display
Dynamic: scales with injuries + hit-frequency red pulse
Mild: softer baseline pain
Display: hitpulse/vignette, blur, FOV, audio
Example: /lastaid pain display blur off
Click to fill: /lastaid pain mild
lastaid.tip.commands.suppression.label: Adrenaline
lastaid.tip.commands.suppression.detail:
Projectile near-miss adrenaline
Dynamic/Mild/Off intensity
Visuals: edge vignette + desaturation (cancels morphine sat) + weak warp
Click to fill: /lastaid adrenaline off
lastaid.tip.commands.commandtips.label: Join Tips
lastaid.tip.commands.commandtips.detail:
Show or hide this admin command message on operator join
Click to fill: /lastaid commandtips off
lastaid.tip.commands.medicineeffect.deta:
Set medicine activation timing
realistic: slower and harsher
assisted: balanced default
casual: fastest relief
Click to fill: /lastaid medicineeffect assisted
lastaid.tip.commands.naturalregen.label: Natural Regen
lastaid.tip.commands.naturalregen.detail:
Configure natural regeneration
full: heal into green
limited: stop in yellow
limited2: limited, but skips parts at 0 health
off: disable
critical: prioritize head/body at yellow or below
random: pick a random healable part
Click to fill: /lastaid naturalregen limited critical
lastaid.tip.commands.revivewakeup.label: Wake-up
lastaid.tip.commands.revivewakeup.detail:
Choose whether rescued players wait before standing up
on 15: wake after 15 seconds
off: stand up immediately
Click to fill: /lastaid revivewakeup on 15
lastaid.tip.commands.injurydebuff.label: Debuffs
lastaid.tip.commands.injurydebuff.detail:
Tune injury debuffs globally or per effect
Global example: /lastaid injurydebuff normal
Per-effect example: /lastaid injurydebuff minecraft:slowness off
lastaid.tip.commands.randomdamage.label: Random Damage
lastaid.tip.commands.randomdamage.detail:
Choose random damage behavior
friendly: roll for no-kill critical limbs when possible
friendly chance <percent>: set friendly roll chance
normal: use original random allocation
Click to fill: /lastaid randomdamage friendly chance 80
lastaid.tip.commands.damagepart.label: Damage Test
lastaid.tip.commands.damagepart.detail:
Debug command for applying or healing locational damage
Example: /damagePart HEAD 4
No debuff: /damagePart HEAD 4 nodebuff
lastaid.tip.commands.addiction.label: Addiction
lastaid.tip.commands.addiction.detail:
Admin-only addiction tools
Query: /lastaid addiction <player>
Set: /lastaid addiction set <player> <0-100>
Players cannot view their own addiction
Click to fill: /lastaid addiction set @s 0

lastaid.wound.hint.3: Needs stitches (sewing kit). A bandage only slows it
lastaid.wound.hint.remove_tourniquet: Stitched: take the tourniquet off before the limb dies
lastaid.wound.detail.1: A scratch. Bleeds a little and stops by itself after a minute or two.
lastaid.wound.detail.2: A laceration from a blade, claws or teeth. Keeps bleeding until dressed with a rag or bandage.
lastaid.wound.detail.3: A deep wound (arrow, trident, mace, explosion). Only stitches stop it; a dressing just slows it down. About two minutes to bleed out.
lastaid.wound.detail.4: Arterial bleeding. Death in under a minute. A tourniquet on the limb stops it at once, then stitch the wound and take the tourniquet off within 15 minutes.
lastaid.wound.detail.dressing: A dressing on healed skin. It still gets dirty; take it off (panel) and wash it.
lastaid.wound.help.extract: Pull the arrow out (3 s, hurts). Left alone it tears out by itself after 5 minutes and leaves a worse wound
lastaid.wound.help.light: Rag, plaster or bandage (apply on this body part); or just wait
lastaid.wound.help.medium: Rag or bandage on this body part
lastaid.wound.help.suture: Sewing kit: Stitch button below (5 s)
lastaid.wound.help.tourniquet: Tourniquet: stops it instantly, but no longer than 15 minutes
lastaid.wound.help.alcohol: Alcohol on the wound: -80% infection chance
lastaid.wound.help.dirty: Change dirty dressings: a dirty one left on for a day causes an infection
lastaid.tourniquet.on: %s: tourniquet on. Take it off within 15 minutes!
lastaid.tourniquet.warn: %s: the tourniquet has been on for 10 minutes. The limb is going numb
lastaid.tourniquet.necrosis: %s: the tourniquet stayed on too long. The limb is dead
lastaid.dressing.plaster_weak: %s: a plaster can't hold this wound
lastaid.dressing.not_enough: %s: the dressing only slows it down. Needs stitches
lastaid.dressing.dirty: %s: the dressing is dirty, change it
lastaid.dressing.removed_bleeding: %s: dressing off, the wound opened again
lastaid.dressing.hint.dirty: Dirty dressing: take it off and put on a clean one
lastaid.dressing.hint.healed: The wound has healed, the dressing can come off
lastaid.dressing.wash_need_water: Wash it in water, or carry a water bottle
lastaid.infection.hint.1: Alcohol on the wound and a clean dressing: heals by itself
lastaid.infection.hint.2: Antibiotic (one a day) and keep the wound clean
lastaid.infection.hint.4: Sepsis! Antibiotic at once, or lose the limb
lastaid.infection.detail: Bacteria got into a wound. Without treatment it gets one stage worse about every half a game day: fever, weakness, then sepsis. Sepsis from an arm or leg kills the limb (only amputation helps), and amputating the infected limb takes the source away.
lastaid.infection.effects.2: Slowness I, Weakness I, fever, -0.3 HP every 30 s
lastaid.infection.effects.3: Slowness II, Weakness II, Mining Fatigue, high fever, -0.5 HP every 10 s
lastaid.infection.effects.4: Blackouts, high fever, -1 HP every 10 s, the limb dies
lastaid.infection.help.antibiotic: Antibiotic: -1 stage, no worsening for a day (one per day)
lastaid.infection.help.clean: Stage 1: alcohol on the wound and a clean dressing
lastaid.infection.help.amputate: Last resort: amputate the infected limb
lastaid.infection.worse.3: Severe infection: high fever, you're weak
lastaid.infection.worse.4: Sepsis! You need an antibiotic right now
lastaid.infection.source_removed: The infected limb is gone: the infection weakens
lastaid.infection.necrosis: %s: sepsis killed the limb tissue. Only amputation now
lastaid.antibiotic.prevent: Antibiotic: no infection, it protects you for a day
lastaid.antibiotic.too_soon: Too soon, the last dose still works
lastaid.anemia.start: You lost a lot of blood: anemia. Eat meat or bread and rest
lastaid.anemia.food: Food helps you recover from blood loss
lastaid.anemia.hint: Meat, bread and sleep speed it up
lastaid.anemia.detail: Too much blood lost in a short time. Slowness I, Weakness I, -10% damage for about a game day.
item.lastaid.defibrillator.desc: Brings a player in critical condition back. 3 uses
